ideas.name: a strong signal bar: body 60% of its range or more
ideas.why: a full-bodied bar is one side in control from open to close; a small body is indecision

ideas.name: the last 3 one-minute closes each its way
ideas.why: consecutive closes are steady aggression, not one print through a level

ideas.name: volume rising into the break (last 3 minutes over the 3 before)
ideas.why: participation building as the level breaks is new money arriving

ideas.name: no rejection wick (the far wick under a quarter of the bar)
ideas.why: a long wick at the breakout's end is the level's sellers (buyers) already answering

ideas.name: within 1 two-minute ATR of the 1m EMA 21
ideas.why: a breakout far above its short average is stretched; the first pullback comes before the target

ideas.name: the 1m MACD histogram growing its way
ideas.why: accelerating momentum: the push is gaining force at the break, not fading

ideas.name: the signal bar closes beyond the bar before's extreme
ideas.why: follow-through: the break held to the close beyond the last bar, not a wick through it

ideas.name: the last closed 5-minute bar closed its way
ideas.why: the slower bar agreeing shows the move is more than a 2-minute burst
